generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The Tenders/ Bids are invited as per Standard tender Bid Document KW-4 The contractor shall attach all the requisite documents as required in the standard bid document. The Bidders shall abide as per the detailed instructions and conditions contained in standard bid document KW-4
The Department is not responsible for any delay caused in accessing the e-procurement portal.

The Employer reseves the right to accept or reject any tender and to cancel the tender process and reject all tenders at any time prior to the award of contract without there by incurring any liability to the affected tendere or tenderers or any obligation to inform the affected Tenderer or Tenderers of the grounds for the Emplyoers action
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
Blacklisted agencies are not eligible to participate in the tender

The tenderer shall scan original Workdone certificates/Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening.
Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the submitted tender bid shall be liable to be rejected
The earnest money deposit will be forfeited if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading/forged or fake.
The contractors shall collect necessary samples as required & all relevant requisite tests to be got done by the registered institution or firms with consultants with the Third Party.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27-07-2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt, orders as may be modified from time to time
Royalty Charges will be Deducted in every bill of contract as per rules
The tenderer should maintain the Building during the DEFECT LIABILITY PERIOD, which is up to Two years after successful completion of the work.
The Applicable GST shall be paid separately
The Increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time

All safety precautions warning signs night illumination reflectors deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. The contractor should indemnify the client to that extent
Only relevant document needs to be uploaded. un-necessary documents or any kind of fake documents will lead to rejection of tender.
Any Deviation or error or Mistakes found in units of items they should be read as in the unified SR 2023-24 and the rates shall be quoted accordingly

Payment of the bill shall be made subject to the release of funds by the Government. In case the release of grant is delayed for any period, this office shall not be liable to pay any additional amount in any manner.
Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the 2026-27

1.      The surface to be polished is rubbed with sand paper 80/120 no. and then with sand paper of 160/180 no.
2.      Applying two coats of sealer with spray gun and allowing sufficient
drying time for 1st coat and 2nd coat is allowed to dry for 8 to 12 hrs.
3.
